## Prework

I assure that I checked the [issues](https://github.com/andythomas/matr1x/issues), open or closed. If there is an existing issue, comment on the existing thread instead of posting a new issue!

## Description

Describe the bug clearly and concisely.

## Reproducible example

Please provide a Minimal Reproducible Example (MRE):

- Runnable: Includes code/data to reproduce the issue locally.
- Minimal: Stripped of all non-essential details and code.

## Expected result

Expected Behavior: Describe what should have happened.

## Development environment

- Please provide a screenshot of the "About" pop-up window of any GUI application.
- Please append the corresponding log tail, supposedly located at `~/logs`.
